needed.evidence: There is no designated sidewalk or informal path on the left side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk in the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from motor traffic.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right side is uneven with dirt and potholes.
